sourceRefs.locator: No. 22, beginning on p. 49: original AN K 4 no. 7; Corbery, competing claims of Saint-Denis and Sept-Meules, and dating by Childeric’s ninth year.

Heading, opening and dating clause: 1 March 752, Verberie, rex Francorum. Narrative: Loba’s testament, Gislemar’s admission and surrender per festucam, Fulrad, and the preceding hearing before King Chilperic.

summary.de: Er vertrat seine Abtei in den Verfahren von Attigny und Verberie.
summary.en: He pleaded his abbey’s cases at the hearings at Attigny and Verberie.
